note: Triennial election of Omagh Rural District Council, polled Thursday 1 June 1961. There was no contest in the district: all 39 members were returned unopposed after Mr. Fred Giboney withdrew in Bencran. Mr. Fred Giboney, nominated as an unofficial Unionist, withdrew his candidature and Mr. M'Ivor was returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
